notes.title: Update #2 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians!

We’ve just released a new update that improves many aspects of the game, thanks to your feedback! Your input has been incredibly valuable and we’re excited to share these improvements with you.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3169510/extras/LL_8-ezgif.com-overlay.gif?t=1741952095[/img]

[h1]Key Changes & Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enemy Edge Pointers – Now you can see where off-screen enemies are coming from
[*] Building Info in Tutorial – Added information panels to help new players understand buildings better
[*] More Visible Enemy Spawner Info – Added clearer indicators and path markers leading to the core
[*] Player Skill Reminder – UI now shows when your special skill is ready to use
[*] Low Ammo Warning – You’ll now get a heads-up when you're on your last magazine
[*] Enemy Healer "Transfuser" Improvements – better behavior and a more visible healing effect
[*] Interactable Building Reminder – Indicators above buildings that can be manually activated
[*] Improved HUB UI – UI is now more intuitive with a proper close button
[*] Distinct Enemy Colors – Different enemies now have unique colors for better visibility
[*] Audio Tweaks – Improved weapon sounds, reload effects, and out-of-ammo alerts.
[/list]

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3169510/extras/LL_4-ezgif.com-overlay.gif?t=1741952095[/img]

[h1]Keep the Feedback Coming![/h1]
Your feedback directly shapes the game and we’d love to hear more from you! If you haven’t already, please try out the demo and leave a review on our Steam page. Reviews help us improve the game and also make it more visible to others!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534560/Last_Line_Demo/

Want to chat directly with us and other players? Join our Discord community to share your thoughts: https://discord.gg/fu2QhfKyRc

Thanks for playing, and see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: 📢 What is Last Line? – A New Take on Tower Defense & Twin-Stick Shooting!
notes.notes:
[b]NOT[/b] a passive Tower Defense - [b]NOT[/b] repetetive Twin-Stick Shooter? Then what is this?

[previewyoutube=Ydjh5chTwSA;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to take a moment to introduce [b]Last Line[/b] and make clear what this game is about!
If you enjoy games like [b]Sanctum 2[/b], you’re in for a treat because that’s one of our biggest inspirations.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3534560/extras/LL_7-ezgif.com-overlay.gif?t=1741604134[/img]


You don’t just shoot waves of enemies—you build, strategize and adapt to survive. You can create elaborate maze-like defenses, set up powerful turrets and then jump into the action yourself with fast-paced twin-stick combat. 
Planning is just as important as shooting—if you don’t think ahead, you’ll quickly get overwhelmed.


🔹 4 Playable Characters – Each with unique skills and a deep perk tree for customization
🔹 Build & Defend – Place walls, turrets and traps to create deadly kill zones
🔹 Intense Combat – Use a variety of weapons and abilities to fight off relentless waves
🔹 Strategy Matters – Smart base-building and resource management are key to survival


[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3534560/extras/LL_8-ezgif.com-overlay.gif?t=1741604134[/img]

As you progress, you’ll unlock new weapons, turrets, and perks, letting you fine-tune your playstyle. Completing campaign missions will grant access to better defenses and stronger firepower, keeping you prepared for even tougher challenges.

The campaign isn’t just about surviving—it’s about adapting. Each mission introduces new mechanics and level layouts, forcing you to rethink your strategies. From open battlefields to tight corridors, each map brings a unique challenge.

You don’t have to fight alone! Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op and combine your strategies. Coordinate base-building, cover each other’s weak spots, and unleash chaos together!

The demo is live right now and we’d love to hear what you think! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534560/Last_Line_Demo/

Your feedback helps us improve the game before launch. If [b]Last Line[/b] sounds like your kind of game, please [b]Wishlist[/b] it on Steam and let us know your thoughts.

Try the demo, test your skills and help shape the game! 🚀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169510/Last_Line/
